text:
maria: Heads up - AWS Marketplace settlement shows a -$4,200 adjustment for partner ACME on invoice ACME-2026-03. Looks like duplicate UsageRecords in US-EAST-1 around 2026-03-12. Can someone investigate?
aws-billing-bot: Automated scan flagged duplicate UsageRecords for product p-0abc123. TX ids: tx-9876, tx-9877.
sam: I'll open an AWS case. @maria please attach any S3 exports from 2026-03-12.
paul: Partner says their internal billing doesn't show a credit; they're asking if this is AWS or us.
rachel: Placing a hold JE-2026-03-ACME-HOLD for -4200 until confirmed.
kevin: Our ingestion retried at ~02:12Z due to a timeout; possible duplicate submission.
sam: Snippet from AWS export: ```csv
2026-03-12T02:11:02Z,tx-9876,100
2026-03-12T02:11:05Z,tx-9876,100
2026-03-12T02:15:30Z,tx-9877,220
2026-03-12T02:15:33Z,tx-9877,220
```
sam: AWS case 1234567890 opened.
aws-billing-bot: Case 1234567890 status: UNDER_REVIEW.
sam: Update: AWS confirmed duplicate ingestion from a routing retry and issued PartnerAdjustment PA-20260320-ACME for $4,200 dated 2026-03-20.
paul: We'll mirror the credit on ACME's March invoice and notify them. Draft message ready.
rachel: Removed hold and created JE-2026-03-ACME-CREDIT referencing PA-20260320-ACME. Will post once I have screenshot.
kevin: Deployed a dedupe fix by tx id (refs/ingest/dedupe-2026-03).
maria: Tag me when the screenshot is in and I'll approve the GL. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
paul: Notified ACME; they requested a short reconciliation note for their finance team.
sam: Case 1234567890 closed: resolution "Duplicate UsageRecord consolidation". Reopening only if AWS reverts.
